classificationReason: The account projection is email-only as required by the provider contract, with server action gating, AR/EN direction, safe update feedback, and no phone identity field. Visual closure remains open because the no-update desktop snapshot compares a 1280x954 runtime with an existing 1280x1182 baseline; the baseline contains stale account content and the shared Provider shell is outside this lane.

runtime.authorization: Anonymous sessions do not load settings; the email input and save action are disabled, and submit is a no-op, when update_email is absent from the server-projected availableActions.
runtime.projection: The account form renders the projected email only. Phone labels and phone values are absent; contact data is not copied into the account identity form.
runtime.navigationAndFocus: Account, contact, and security tab links preserve /provider/settings with tab and locale query parameters; labeled form controls and status/alert feedback are exposed.

repairs.defect: Account and contact save controls could remain actionable regardless of server-projected availableActions.
repairs.effect: Inputs and submit controls are disabled and the save handler returns without mutation when the corresponding server action is unavailable.

repairs.defect: Provider settings feedback branches did not clearly group the 401/403 permission statuses.
repairs.effect: Unauthorized and forbidden update responses consistently map to the permission feedback state.

verification.command: npm.cmd run test:vitest --workspace apps/web -- tests/provider-notifications-settings.vitest.test.tsx --run -t "uses only|for ar|for en|permission state|fails closed|renders empty|maps notification|honors server|maps settings|contact fields"

verification.result: Account route, direction, provider projection, focus, and save-success assertions passed before the no-update snapshot failed at 1280x954 versus the existing 1280x1182 baseline for AR and EN.
